method: Each definition in s3-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its named test run alone (vitest -t), every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the test rerun. Integration tests run on local PostgreSQL with the real schema built from the migrations; PayPal is the labeled fixture fake at the PayPalWriteClient boundary and webhook signatures use the fixture postback.
